intro.text: One of the people Tress claims died when the Oot's Dream went down; she most likely invented them.

items.text: Tress claimed that Kaplan, Marple and Mallory, who supposedly died with the Oot's Dream, were her relatives. She hoped Crow would let her slip away at Shimmerbay and spread word that the Crow's Song were deadrunners, which suited Crow's plan and would free Tress to find another ship to Kingsport.
